question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"almost."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In this context, we need a word which means** "very nearly."** • **"Almost"** means very nearly or very close to. (लगभग; क़रीब-क़रीब) • It indicates that the action or state being described is not quite complete or not quite achieved. • **Example**:* I **almost**__ missed my flight.* • The correct answer is Option 1.​ • Correct passage: Cancer is a disease in which some of the body’s cells grow __uncontrollably__ and spread to other parts of the body. Cancer can start __almost__ anywhere in the human body, which is made up of trillions of cells. Normally, human cells grow and multiply (through a process called cell division) to ______ (3) ______ new cells as the body needs them. When cells grow old or become damaged, they die, and new cells take their place. Sometimes, this orderly process ______ (4) ______ down, and abnormal or damaged cells grow and multiply when they shouldn’t. These cells may form tumours, which are lumps of tissue. Tumours can be cancerous or ______ (5) ______. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (just)** means recently or only a short time ago. (अभी-अभी, हाल ही में, एकदम पहले) • **Option 3 (barely)** means only just; almost not. ((विशेषतः ‘can’ और ‘could’ के बाद प्रयुक्त-इस बात पर बल देने के लिए कि अमुक काम कठिन है) मुश्किल से, कठिनाई से) • **Option 4 (simply)** means merely or only; just. (किसी बात के आसान और प्रारंभिक या मामूली होने पर बल देने के लिए प्रयुक्त) 3f:Tf97, The correct answer is **"form."**
